title: fix(plugin-grid): on a phone a grid card takes the tap of its one-line record link
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb1CAYkjLqr8rNMW513K8cmz)_

Fixes #29219

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机宽度（768 px 以下，表格变成卡片的那条断点）下，网格卡片副标题里的记录链接不再自己接收点按：链接加了 `max-md:pointer-events-none`，点到链接文字时由外层卡片接住，卡片打开的是同一条记录。链接仍可获得焦点，键盘 Enter / 空格照常打开记录。桌面表格不变。
- **为什么改**：移动端 App 用 WebView 承载 Console。实测 375 / 390 px 下，记录页相关列表（如客户的「Activities」「Opportunities」「Contacts」）的卡片里，链接只有 16–22 px 高，远低于 44 px 手指目标；而它所在的卡片有 56–62 px 高、整行宽，本来就打开同一条记录。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只加一个 class；卡片高度不变（实测 56 / 62 px 前后一致）；768 px 以上表格里的链接仍是自己的点按目标（实测 `pointer-events: auto`）。不加键、prop、导出或文案，不碰 `ObjectGrid.tsx`。回滚即回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridLinkCell.tsx` 的 `LINK_CELL_CLASS`；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.phoneLinkTapTarget-29219.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.phoneLinkTapTarget-29219.test.tsx`，预期 4 个用例通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Below 768 px `ObjectGrid` draws every row as a phone card (`useObjectGridMobile`'s breakpoint), and the card opens the record through `navigation.handleClick(row)`. When a view's first column is not the object's name field, the card is titled by the name field and draws that first column, as the record link, in its subtitle: one text line. The link opens the same record through the same `navigation.handleClick(row)`.

`LINK_CELL_CLASS` in `objectGridLinkCell.tsx` gains one token, `max-md:pointer-events-none`. Below 768 px a tap on the link's text goes through to the card. The wrapping variant (`wrap: true`) derives from the same list and carries it too. The link keeps its `href`, its focus and its keyboard activation (Enter natively on the anchor, Space through its handler). From 768 px up, where the grid draws the table, nothing changes.

`max-md:` rather than `max-sm:` on purpose: between 640 and 767 px the grid still draws cards, so the token covers exactly the card face.

No key, prop, export, string or spec surface is added. `ObjectGrid.tsx` is not touched.

## Measurements

Production `/_console` (`pnpm build && pnpm console:build`), `examples/app-crm` and the showcase on `--fresh` backends, Chromium with touch, at 375×812 and 390×844 (the two widths read the same; card width 311 / 326 px).

**Where the link appears at phone width (main `47ee57fe`).**

| Surface | Link | Card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CRM account record, Activities tab (`?related=crm_activity.account`) | "Meeting" / "Call", 22 px tall, 43–68 px wide | 62 px |
| CRM account record, Opportunities tab | amounts, 16 px tall | 56 px |
| CRM account record, Contacts tab | email, 16 px tall | 56 px |
| Full lists: all 6 CRM objects, all 17 showcase objects | none (the first column is the name field, which titles the card as text) | 56–62 px |
| Showcase account and project record tabs | none | — |
| Desktop 1280, Activities tab | 22 px link in a 41 px table row | — |

A live tap on the card and a tap on the link opened the same record URL.

**Three shapes, emulated live with injected CSS on main, read at 375 and 390** (share of a 10×5 px tap grid over the card):

| Shape | Card height | Taps on link / on card | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A. The row grows (`min-h-11 flex items-center` on the link) | 56 → 84, 62 → 84 | 0.04–0.11 / 0.89–0.95 | every related card with a subtitle link grows 22–28 px |
| B. Stretched link (`after:absolute after:inset-0` on the link, `relative` on the card) | unchanged | 1.00 / 0 | needs the card's class in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, and the overlay covers every other control in the card |
| D. The card takes the tap (`pointer-events: none` on the link), **this PR** | unchanged | 0 / 0.99 | none measured |

**After, on this branch's build (head `7d293c02`).**

- 375, 390 and 700 px: on every card of the three related tabs, the link reads `pointer-events: none`, a point at the link's centre resolves to the card, and the card takes 0.99–1.00 of the tap grid. Card heights are 56 and 62 px, unchanged.
- A real touch tap on the link's text lands on the link's own record path at both widths (Activities, Opportunities, Contacts).
- 1280 px: the link reads `pointer-events: auto`, and a point at its centre resolves to the link, as on main.

## Tests

- `ObjectGrid.phoneLinkTapTarget-29219.test.tsx` (new), on the real `ObjectGrid` at 375 px with a view that leads with a non-name column: the subtitle's anchor carries `max-md:pointer-events-none` (not a `max-sm:` variant); a `wrap: true` column keeps it in the wrapping variant; a click on the card opens that row exactly once; the link takes focus and Space opens the row. It does not assume the card has no other control.
- `ObjectGrid.linkCellAnchor.test.tsx`: its full-markup pin of the no-host `span` gains the token.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the token removed from `LINK_CELL_CLASS`, restored to blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`): the two token cases fail ("expected false to be true") and so does the markup pin; the click and keyboard cases stay green, which makes them controls.

## Acceptance notes

- The card taking the tap is the existing behaviour: `grid-mobile-card` already ran `navigation.handleClick(row)`, the call the link's `onActivate` makes. The link's own modifier-click split (new tab) does not apply on a touch screen.
- #29150 is adding a row-action menu to the same card; the new test asserts nothing about other controls in the card, and nothing in this diff covers them.
- Before and after screenshots of the Activities tab at 375 px and the measuring scripts are in the project folder, not on GitHub.
